services.name: Inside: Phone Check
services.description: A warm, clear look at your whole phone: checks, hardware, battery, performance, charging.

services.name: Tuck: AI Screenshot Organizer
services.description: Screenshots piling up? Tuck's AI reads every screenshot and file you save: bookings, receipts and warranties, and the restaurants, recipes and things to buy you screenshot. It files each one and finds it again from a few words. Reading happens on your device, with Apple Intelligence where available; Advanced reading by Claude is optional.

services.name: ZaiRi: Plant Watering Reminder
services.description: Give every plant day a place to grow.

services.name: Roomory: Floor Plans
services.description: From moving a sofa to planning a renovation, Roomory helps you turn the space you have into the layout you want. Scan a room or start by hand, then edit your floor plans and preview your ideas in 3D.

services.name: Nightvane: Star Guide
services.description: Hold your iPhone or iPad up to the night and Nightvane shows what you are looking at: stars, planets, constellations, the Moon and the Milky Way, right where they are.

services.name: Lockwater: Canal Puzzle
services.description: Lockwater is a canal puzzle made of soft clay: a row of stone chambers, a few wooden gates, and boats that must reach the flag of their color.

services.name: Prawnlight: Prawn Hall Tycoon
services.description: Prawnlight is a management game set in a Taiwanese indoor prawn-fishing hall that stays open late into the night. You are the boss, not the angler: order stock, release prawns, lay out the floor, hire staff and keep the guests fishing until closing time.

services.name: Precision Parking 3D
services.description: Slow down. Find your angle. Make every space count.
